name: @sahiljena/react-webview-debugger
description: A lightweight React WebView Debugger panel for cookies, storage, console, network, and features
author: Sahil Jena

scripts.release:patch: npm run build && npm version patch && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run build && npm version minor && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm run build && npm version major && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags
